# Class: McObject

[2d](../modules/2d.md).McObject

McObject is the main control object of MxCAD, responsible for undertaking the core capabilities of CAD application instances.

**`Description`**

This class is not a regular entity object, but rather the "controller/entry point" for the entire MxCAD runtime.
It can accomplish:
-Retrieve the current CAD instance and operate the graphics database;
-Register and handle various events (such as selection changes, file opening completion, database modifications);
-Call up drawing, redrawing, coordinate conversion, temporary display and other abilities;
-Set global display and running parameters.

Usage:
1. First, obtain the current CAD instance through MxCpp. getCurrentMxCAD() or MxCpp. mxcad;
2. Call its methods again for drawing, interaction, or status monitoring;
If you need to create a new independent instance, first use new McObject (), and then call create (config) to initialize it.

**`Example`**

```ts
import { MxCpp } from "mxcad";

const mxcad = MxCpp.getCurrentMxCAD();

//Read the current open file name
console.log(mxcad.currentFileName);

//Registration selection change event
mxcad.on("selectChange", (ids) => {
Console.log ("number of selected objects:", ids. length);
});
```

**`Remarks`**

Applicable scenarios include:
-Secondary development plugins: monitoring object selection, file opening, database changes;
-Custom drawing: temporary highlighting, dynamic preview, auxiliary annotation;
-Graphic operations: add/modify entities, redraw views, control display parameters;
-Interactive development: Integrate with MxDraw and MxCAD event systems.

### constructor

• **new McObject**(`imp?`)

Create a McObject instance.

This constructor is usually only used when you need to manually create a standalone instance.
If you only want to operate on the currently running CAD window, prioritize using MxCpp. getCurrentMxCAD() or MxCpp. mxcad.

#### Parameters

| Name | Type | Description |
| :------ | :------ | :------ |
| `imp? `| ` any ` | The underlying implementation object; Usually injected automatically by the system, developers generally do not need to manually input it.  |

### drawPatternDefinition

• `get` **drawPatternDefinition**(): `string`

Get the current line type definition drawn

#### Returns

`string`

**`Example`**

```ts
import { MxCpp, McObject } from "mxcad"
 const mxcad: McObject = MxCpp.getCurrentMxCAD()
//Draw another patterned fill
   //45, 0,0, 0,.25
   //45, .176776695,0, 0,.25, .125,-.0625
   mxcad.addPatternDefinition("MyHatchPattern2", "((45, 0,0, 0,0.25) (45, 0.176776695,0, 0,0.25, 0.125,-0.0625))");
   mxcad.drawPatternDefinition = "MyHatchPattern2"
//Define the starting point of a path
   mxcad.pathMoveToEx(800, 3300, 0, 0, 0.3);
//The next point on the path
   mxcad.pathLineTo(900, 3300);
//The next point on the path
   mxcad.pathLineTo(900, 3400);
//The next point on the path
   mxcad.pathLineTo(800, 3300);
//Transform the path into a fill, where 80 is the scaling ratio of the fill pattern
   mxcad.drawPathToHatch(80);
```

## Methods

### AddTureTypeTextStyle

▸ **AddTureTypeTextStyle**(`sName`, `sTrueTypeFontName?`, `dXScale?`): [`McObjectId`](2d.McObjectId.md)

Add text styles using TrueType fonts

#### Parameters

| Name | Type | Default value | Description |
| :------ | :------ | :------ | :------ |
| `sName` | `string` | `undefined` | - |
|STrueTypeFontName | string | "" | TrueType font name, if left blank, use the default TrueType font|
|DXScale | number | 1.0 | X-direction scaling ratio|

#### Returns

[`McObjectId`](2d.McObjectId.md)

**`Example`**

```ts
//Using TrueType fonts for text styles in MxCAD
import { MxCpp } from "mxcad"

   function Mx_Test_TrueText() {
       let mat: McGeMatrix3d = new McGeMatrix3d();
       let mxcad = MxCpp.getCurrentMxCAD();
//Clear the current display content
       mxcad.newFile();
       MxCpp.App.loadFonts([], [], ["syadobe", "simsun", "sysimsun"], () => {
           mxcad.AddTureTypeTextStyle("ht_style", "syadobe");
           mxcad.AddTureTypeTextStyle("st_style", "simsun");
           mxcad.drawTextStyle = "ht_style";

           mxcad.drawColor = new McCmColor(200, 255, 50);
Let idText=mxcad.drawText (0, 3500, "TrueType Text Test for Drawing Control", 100, 0, 0, 1);

           let ent = idText.getMcDbEntity();
           if (ent) ent.textStyle = "st_style";

           let txt: McDbText = ent as McDbText;
           txt.adjustAlignment();
           mxcad.zoomAll();
           mxcad.regen();
           mxcad.updateDisplay();
       });
   }
```

### addDimStyle

▸ **addDimStyle**(`pszName`, `pszDoubleData`, `pszIntData`, `pszStringData`, `pszIdData`): [`McObjectId`](2d.McObjectId.md)

Add annotation style

#### Parameters

| Name | Type | Description |
| :------ | :------ | :------ |
|PszName | string | Style Name|
|PszDoubleData | string | Double precision data|
|PszIntData | string | integer data|
|` pszStringData ` | ` string ` | String data|
|PszIdData | string | ID type data|

#### Returns

[`McObjectId`](2d.McObjectId.md)

**`Description`**

PszDoubleData Double Precision Data
|System Variables | Values | Function Description|
| ------- | ------- | ------- |
|Dimaltf | 143 | Control the multiplier for converting units|
|Dimasz | 41 | Control the size of dimension lines and lead arrows. And control the size of the baseline|
|Dimcen | 141 | Control the marking of circle or arc centers and the drawing of centerlines|
|Dimdle | 46 | When using a small diagonal line instead of an arrow for annotation, set the distance from the dimension line beyond the dimension boundary line|
|Dimdli | 43 | Control the spacing of dimension lines in baseline annotation|
|Dimexe | 44 | Export named annotation styles and their settings to an external file|
|Dimexo | 42 | Specify the distance from the origin of the dimension extension line|
|Dimgap | 147 | Set the distance around the annotation text when the dimension line is broken to conform to the annotation text|
|Dimlfac | 144 | Set the scaling factor for linear annotation measurement values|
|Dimrnd | 45 | Rounds all annotated distances to the specified value|
|Dimscale | 40 | Set the global scale factor applied to the annotation variable (used to specify size, distance, or offset)|
|Dimtfac | 146 | As set through the DIMTXT system variable, specify the scaling factor of the text height of the score and tolerance values relative to the annotation text height|
|Dimtm | 48 | Set the minimum (i.e. lowest) tolerance limit for the annotation text|
|Dimtp | 47 | Set the maximum (i.e. highest) tolerance limit for the annotation text|
|Dimtsz | 142 | DIMTSZ=0 Using standard solid arrows, arrows marked with DIMTSZ>0 are replaced with sloping lines (building markings), and the value of DIMTSZ is the length of this sloping line|
|Dimtvp | 145 | Control the vertical position of the annotation text above or below the dimension line|
|Dimtxt | 140 | Specify the height of the annotation text (unless the current text style has a fixed height)|
|Dimaltrnd | 148 | Rounding conversion annotation unit|

**`Description`**

PszIntData integer data
|System Variables | Values | Function Description|
| ------- | ------- | ------- |
|Dimadec | 179 | Control the precision decimal places displayed in the angle annotation|
|Dimalt | 170 | Controls the display of conversion units in annotations|
|Dimaltd | 171 | Control the number of decimal places in the conversion unit|
|Dimalttd | 274 | Set the decimal place for the tolerance value in the conversion annotation unit|
|Dimalttz | 286 | Control the zeroing process of tolerance values|
|Dimaltu | 273 | Set the unit format for the conversion units of all annotation sub styles (excluding angular annotations)|
|Dimaltz | 285 | Control the zeroing process for the annotation values of conversion units|
|Dimaunit | 275 | Set the unit format for angle annotation|
|Dimclrd | 176 | Specify colors for dimension lines, arrows, and dimension leaders|
|Dimctre | 177 | Specify colors for dimension lines, center marks, and centerlines|
|Dimclrt | 178 | Specify the color for the annotation text|
|Dimdec | 271 | Set the number of decimal places displayed in the primary unit of the annotation|
|When the space within the dimension line is insufficient to accommodate both the annotation text and the arrow, this system variable will determine the arrangement of both|
|Dimjust | 280 | Control the horizontal position of the annotation text|
|Dimlim | 72 | Generate annotation boundaries as default text|
|Dimsah | 173 | Control the display of dimension line arrow blocks|
|Dimsd1 | 281 | Control whether to hide the first dimension line and arrow|
|Dimsd2 | 282 | Control whether to hide the second dimension line and arrow|
|Dimse1 | 75 | Control whether to hide the first dimension line|
|Dimse2 | 76 | Control whether to hide the second dimension line|
|Dimsoxd | 175 | If there is not enough space within the dimension line, hide the arrow|
|Dimtad | 77 | Control the vertical position of the text relative to the dimension line|
|Dimtdec | 272 | Set the number of decimal places displayed in the tolerance value of the primary unit of the annotation|
|Dimtih | 73 | Controls the position of annotation text for all annotation types (excluding coordinate annotations) within the dimension lines|
|Dimtix | 174 | Draw text between dimension lines|
|Dimtofl | 172 | Controls whether dimension lines are drawn between dimension lines (even if the dimension text is placed outside the dimension lines)|
|Dimitoh | 74 | Control the position of the annotation text outside the dimension line|
|Ditol | 71 | Attach the tolerance in the annotation text|
|Dimtolj | 283 | Set the vertical alignment of tolerance values relative to surface annotation text|
|Dimzin | 78 | Control the zeroing process for the main unit value|
|Dimupt | 288 | Control the option for users to locate text|
|Dimtzin | 284 | Control the zeroing process of tolerance values|
|Dimfrac | 276 | Set score format|
|Dimlunit | 277 | Set units for all annotation types (excluding angular annotations)|
|When the space within the dimension line is insufficient to accommodate both the annotation text and the arrow, this system variable will determine the arrangement of both|
|Dimtmove | 279 | Set the movement rules for annotation text|
|Dimazin | 79 | Zero elimination processing for angle annotation|

**`Description`**

PszStringData string type data
|System Variables | Values | Function Description|
| ------- | ------- | ------- |
|Dimapost | 4 | Specify the text prefix or suffix (or both) used for converting dimension measurements for all dimension types (excluding angular dimensions)|
|Dimpost | 3 | Specify a text prefix or suffix (or both) for annotating measurement values|

**`Description`**

PszIdData ID type data
|System Variables | Values | Function Description|
| ------- | ------- | ------- |
|Dimblk | 342 | Set an arrow for the second endpoint of the dimension line|
|Dimblk1 | 343 | Set an arrow for the first endpoint of the dimension line|
|Dimblk2 | 344 | Set an arrow for the second endpoint of the dimension line|
|Dimldrblk | 341 | Specify the type of leader arrow|
|Dimtxsty | 340 | Specify the text style for the annotation|

**`Example`**

```ts
import { MxCpp, McObject } from "mxcad"
 const mxcad:McObject = MxCpp.getCurrentMxCAD();
//Clear the current display content
   mxcad.newFile();
//Create a new text style
Let textId=mxcad. addTextCtyle ("My Annotation Font", "txt. shx", "gbcbig. shx", 1);
//Create a new annotation style
   mxcad.addDimStyle("MyDimStyle", "41,0.18,141,0.09,40,200", "77,1,271,3", '3,"%%c<>"', `340,${textId.id}`);
   mxcad.drawDimStyle = "MyDimStyle"

   mxcad.drawDimAligned(0, 4000, 300, 4500, 150, 4600);
//Put all entities into the current display viewport
   mxcad.zoomAll();
//Update viewport display
   mxcad.updateDisplay();
```

### addImageDefine

▸ **addImageDefine**(`imageUrl`, `sName?`, `isConvertBase64?`, `sourceFileName?`, `sBase64Data?`): [`McObjectId`](2d.McObjectId.md)

Add image definitions to the CAD database for reuse when inserting image objects in the future.

This method is usually used in conjunction with loadImage/drawImage, where the image resources are first loaded into memory,
Register the image definition in the database, and finally insert the image into the drawing using drawImage.

#### Parameters

| Name | Type | Default value | Description |
| :------ | :------ | :------ | :------ |
|ImageURL | string | undefined | Image address.  |
|SName | string | "" | Image Definition Name.  |
|Is the image converted to Base64 data.  |
|Source FileName | string | "" | Image source file name.  |
|SBase64Data | string | "" | Base64 data content.  |

#### Returns

[`McObjectId`](2d.McObjectId.md)

**`Example`**

```ts
import { MxCpp, McObject } from "mxcad";

const mxcad: McObject = MxCpp.getCurrentMxCAD();
const imagUrl = "https://cdn.pixabay.com/photo/2022/11/15/12/23/winter-7593872_960_720.jpg";

mxcad.loadImage(imagUrl, (imagedata) => {
  if (!imagedata) {
    console.log("loadImage failed");
    return;
  }
  mxcad.addImageDefine(imagUrl, "winter-7593872_960_720.jpg", true);
  mxcad.updateDisplay();
});
```

### addPatternDefinition

▸ **addPatternDefinition**(`sName`, `sDefinitionData`): `void`

Add a pattern definition

#### Parameters

| Name | Type | Description |
| :------ | :------ | :------ |
|SName | string | Pattern Name|
|SDefinitionData | string | Pattern default definition data|

#### Returns

`void`

**`Example`**

```ts
   import { MxCpp, McObject } from "mxcad"
   const mxcad:McObject = MxCpp.getCurrentMxCAD()
   //angle, x-origin,y-origin, delta-x,delta-y,dash-1,dash-2, …
//45=angle is the angle of the pattern line
//0=x-origin is the X-coordinate of the point where the first fill line passes through
//0=y-origin is the Y coordinate of the point where the first fill line passes through
//0=delta-x is the X-direction offset of the next fill line relative to the previous line
//0.125=delta-y is the Y-direction offset of the next fill line relative to the previous line
   mxcad.addPatternDefinition("MyHatchPattern1", "((45, 0,0, 0,0.125))");
   mxcad.drawPatternDefinition = "MyHatchPattern1";
//Define the starting point of a path
   mxcad.pathMoveToEx(600, 3300, 0, 0, 0.3);
//The next point on the path
   mxcad.pathLineTo(700, 3300);
//The next point on the path
   mxcad.pathLineTo(700, 3400);
//The next point on the path
   mxcad.pathLineTo(600, 3300);
//Transform the path into a fill, where 80 is the scaling ratio of the fill pattern
   mxcad.drawPathToHatch(80);
```

### create

▸ **create**(`config`): `void`

Create and initialize an MxCAD instance.

This method will start the CAD runtime and complete initialization based on the passed configuration.
Suitable for embedding a new CAD container in the page, loading custom files, or creating independent instances.
If only operating on existing CAD windows on the current page, there is usually no need to manually call this method.

#### Parameters

| Name | Type | Description |
| :------ | :------ | :------ |
|` config ` | [` MxCadConfig `] (../interfaces/2d. MxCadConfig. md) | The initialization configuration for creating MxCad usually includes information such as canvas, locateFile, fileURL, fontspath, etc.  |

#### Returns

`void`

**`Example`**

```ts
import { McObject } from "mxcad";

const mxcad = new McObject();
mxcad.create({
  canvas: "#myCanvas",
  locateFile: (fileName) => new URL(`/node_modules/mxcad/dist/wasm/2d/${fileName}`, import.meta.url).href,
  fileUrl: new URL("../src/assets/test.mxweb", import.meta.url).href,
  fontspath: new URL("node_modules/mxcad/dist/fonts", import.meta.url).href,
});
```

### drawHatch

▸ **drawHatch**(`hatch`, `dPatternScale?`): [`McObjectId`](2d.McObjectId.md)

Draw Fill Object

#### Parameters

| Name | Type | Default value |
| :------ | :------ | :------ |
| `hatch` | [`McDbHatch`](2d.McDbHatch.md) | `undefined` |
| `dPatternScale` | `number` | `1.0` |

#### Returns

[`McObjectId`](2d.McObjectId.md)

Draw object ID

**`Example`**

```ts
import { MxCADUiPrPoint, MxCADUtility, MxCpp, McGePoint3d } from "mxcad";

    async function Mx_TestDrawHatchFormPoint() {
        const getPoint = new MxCADUiPrPoint();
GetPoint.setMessage ("\ nSpecify a point inside the filled area:");
        getPoint.disableAllTrace(true);
        getPoint.setDisableOsnap(true);
        let pt = (await getPoint.go()) as McGePoint3d;
        if (!pt) return;

        let hatch = MxCADUtility.builderHatchFromPoint(pt);
        if (!hatch) {
MxFun.acutPrintf ("Closed area not found")
            return;
        }

        let mxcad = MxCpp.getCurrentMxCAD();
Mxcad. addPatternDefinition ("My Pattern", "(45, 0,0, 0,0.125)");
Mxcad.drawPatternDefinition="My Pattern";
        mxcad.drawHatch(hatch, 5.0);
    }
```

### drawImage

▸ **drawImage**(`dPosX`, `dPosY`, `dWidth`, `dHeight`, `dAng`, `imageName`, `isConvertBase64?`, `dwgImageSizeWidth?`, `dwgImageSizeHeight?`, `imageUrl?`, `sImageBase64?`): [`McObjectId`](2d.McObjectId.md)

Draw an image

#### Parameters

| Name | Type | Default value | Description |
| :------ | :------ | :------ | :------ |
|DPosX | number | undefined | X coordinate of image|
|DPosY | number | undefined | Y coordinate of image|
|DWidth | number | undefined | image width|
|DHeight | number | undefined | Image height|
|DAng | number | undefined | Image angle, in degrees|
| `imageName` | `string` | `undefined` | - |
| `isConvertBase64` | `boolean` | `false` | - |
| `dwgImageSizeWidth` | `number` | `1.0` | - |
| `dwgImageSizeHeight` | `number` | `1.0` | - |
|ImageURL | string | "" | Image path|
| `sImageBase64` | `string` | `""` | - |

#### Returns

[`McObjectId`](2d.McObjectId.md)

**`Example`**

```ts
import { MxCpp } from "mxcad";

   async function Mx_Test_DrawImageBase64() {
       const getPoint = new MxCADUiPrPoint();
GetPoint.setMessage ("\ nSpecify insertion point:");
       let pt = await getPoint.go();
       if (!pt) return;

       let mxcad = MxCpp.getCurrentMxCAD();
       let imagData = "data:image/jpeg;base64,";
       mxcad.loadImageBase64(imagData, "test.jpg", (image) => {
           if (!image) {
               console.log("loadImage failed");
               return;
           }
           let width = mxcad.mxdraw.viewCoordLong2Cad(100);
           let height = (image.height / image.width) * width;

           let viewAngle = 0.0;
           let id = mxcad.drawImage((pt as any).x, (pt as any).y, width, height, viewAngle, "test.jpg", false, image.width, image.height);
           let ent = id.getMcDbEntity();
           if (ent) {
               ent.trueColor = new McCmColor(255, 255, 255, 160);
           }
           mxcad.updateDisplay();
       });
   }
```

### drawPathToHatch

▸ **drawPathToHatch**(`dPatternScale?`): [`McObjectId`](2d.McObjectId.md)

Convert the path to a fill pattern

#### Parameters

| Name | Type | Default value | Description |
| :------ | :------ | :------ | :------ |
|DPatternScale | number | 1.0 | Pattern scaling ratio|

#### Returns

[`McObjectId`](2d.McObjectId.md)

Conversion results

**`Example`**

```ts
   import { MxCADUiPrPoint, MxCADUiPrDist, MxCpp } from "mxcad";
//Solid circle
   async function Mx_SolidCircle() {
       const getCenter = new MxCADUiPrPoint();
GetCenter.setMessage ('Please confirm the center position ');
       const center = await getCenter.go();
       if (!center) return;
       const getRadius = new MxCADUiPrDist();
getRadius.setBasePt(center);//  Set the distance base point as the center of the circle
GetRadius.setMessage ('Please enter circle radius');
       getRadius.setUserDraw((pt, pw) => {
           const r = pt.distanceTo(center);
           const circle = new McDbCircle();
           circle.center = center;
           circle.radius = r;
           pw.drawMcDbEntity(circle)
       })
       const radiusVal = await getRadius.go();
       if (!radiusVal) return;
       const radius = getRadius.value();
       const mxcad = MxCpp.getCurrentMxCAD();
mxcad.pathCircle(center.x, center.y, radius);// Set circular path
mxcad.drawPathToHatch();//  Draw a solid circle
   }
```

### getTempDraw

▸ **getTempDraw**(): [`McObjectTempDraw`](2d.McObjectTempDraw.md)

Get temporary drawing manager.

The object returned by this method is used for "temporary drawing" on the current viewport, such as highlighting selected objects, displaying drag and drop previews, dynamic measurement prompts, etc.
Its characteristic is that it only displays in the view and does not actually write to the graphics database, making it suitable for UI feedback and auxiliary display.

#### Returns

[`McObjectTempDraw`](2d.McObjectTempDraw.md)

To temporarily draw an object, simply call its methods such as addLines/addTriangles/setDrawColor.

**`Example`**

```ts
import { MxCpp } from "mxcad";

const mxcad = MxCpp.getCurrentMxCAD();
const tempDraw = mxcad.getTempDraw();
tempDraw.clearAll();
tempDraw.setDrawColor(0xFF0000);
tempDraw.addLines(new McGePoint3dArray([new McGePoint3d(0, 0, 0), new McGePoint3d(100, 100, 0)]));
```

### insertBlock

▸ **insertBlock**(`sFileUrl`, `sBlkName`, `isWorkThread?`, `fetchAttributes?`, `isUpdataInsertBlock?`, `isUpdataSameNameBlock?`): [`Promise`]( https://developer.mozilla.org/docs/Web/JavaScript/Reference/Global_Objects/Promise )\<[`McObjectId`](2d.McObjectId.md)\>

Plugin block file

#### Parameters

| Name | Type | Default value | Description |
| :------ | :------ | :------ | :------ |
|SFileURL | string | undefined | Network file path This file is in mxweb format|
|SBlkName | string | undefined | The block name of the inserted block|
|IsWorkThread | boolean | true | Whether to use a worker thread to open the file, default to true|
| `fetchAttributes` | `number` | `0` | 1： EMSCRIPTEN_FETCH_LOAD_TO_MEMORY, Load the drawing data into memory, 0: EMSCRIPTEN_FETCH_LOAD_TO_MEMORY \| EMSCRIPTEN_FETCH_PERSIST_FILE \| EMSCRIPTEN_FETCH_APPEND， Add the drawing data to IndexedDB|
|IsUpdataInsertBlock | boolean | false | Update existing blocks, default not updated|
|IsUpdataSameNameBlock | boolean | false | During the process of inserting a block, if a block with the same name is found in the original database, will it also be updated? By default, it will not be updated|

#### Returns

[`Promise`]( https://developer.mozilla.org/docs/Web/JavaScript/Reference/Global_Objects/Promise )\<[`McObjectId`](2d.McObjectId.md)\>

**`Example`**

```ts
import { McDbBlockReference, MxCADUiPrPoint, MxCpp } from "mxcad";
//Insert block
   async function MxTest_InsertBlock() {
       let baseUrl = "http://localhost:3000/mxcad/"
//Set block path
       let blkFilePath = baseUrl + "tree.mxweb";

//Insert block file
       let mxcad = MxCpp.App.getCurrentMxCAD();
       let blkrecId = await mxcad.insertBlock(blkFilePath, "tree");
       if (!blkrecId.isValid()) {
//Insert block
           return;
       }

//Set block size
       let blkRef = new McDbBlockReference();
       blkRef.blockTableRecordId = blkrecId;
       let box = blkRef.getBoundingBox();
       if (box.ret) {
           let dLen = box.maxPt.distanceTo(box.minPt);
           if (dLen > 0.00001) {
               blkRef.setScale(mxcad.getMxDrawObject().screenCoordLong2Doc(100) / dLen);
           }
       }

//Specify insertion base point
       let getPoint = new MxCADUiPrPoint();
GetPoint.setMessage ("\ Specify insertion base point");

//Dynamically drawing blocks
       getPoint.setUserDraw((v, worldDraw) => {
           blkRef.position = v;
           worldDraw.drawMcDbEntity(blkRef);
       });

       let pt = await getPoint.go();
       if (!pt) return;
       blkRef.position = pt;
//Draw blocks
       let newBlkRefId = mxcad.drawEntity(blkRef);
       if (!newBlkRefId.isValid) {
           console.log("insert error");
           return;
       }
   };
```

Commonly used in scenarios such as base image comparison, reference image overlay, and background image display. After successful loading,
The background object will participate in the display in the current drawing's background mode.

| :------ | :------ | :------ | :------ |

|Call | (ret: boolean)=>void | undefined | The callback after loading is complete, with a boolean parameter indicating whether the loading was successful.  |

```ts
import { MxCpp } from "mxcad";

const mxcad = MxCpp.getCurrentMxCAD();

});
```

```ts
import { MxCpp, MxCADUiPrPoint } from "mxcad"

   async function Mx_Test_DrawImage() {
       const getPoint = new MxCADUiPrPoint();
GetPoint.setMessage ("\ nSpecify insertion point:");
       let pt = await getPoint.go();
       if (!pt) return;
       let mxcad = MxCpp.getCurrentMxCAD();
       let imagUrl = "https://cdn.pixabay.com/photo/2022/11/15/12/23/winter-7593872_960_720.jpg";
```

### loadImageBase64

▸ **loadImageBase64**(`sImageBase64`, `imageFileName`, `call`): `void`

Load Base64 image.

#### Parameters

| Name | Type | Description |
| :------ | :------ | :------ |
| `sImageBase64` | `string` | - |
| `imageFileName` | `string` | - |
|Call | (image: any)=>void | callback function|

#### Returns

`void`

**`Example`**

```ts
    import { MxCpp } from "mxcad";
    function selectLocalFile() {
        return new Promise((resolve) => {
            const input = document.createElement("input");
            input.type = "file";
            input.accept = "image/*";
            input.onchange = (e) => resolve(e.target.files[0]);
            input.click();
        });
    }
    function fileToBase64(file) {
        return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
            const reader = new FileReader();
            reader.onload = () => resolve(reader.result);
            reader.onerror = reject;
            reader.readAsDataURL(file);
        });
    }

    const file = await selectLocalFile();
    if (!file) return;
    const imagData = await fileToBase64(file);
    let mxcad = MxCpp.getCurrentMxCAD();

    mxcad.loadImageBase64(imagData, "test.jpg", (image) => {
        if (!image) {
            console.log("loadImage failed");
            return;
        }
        let width = mxcad.mxdraw.viewCoordLong2Cad(100);
        let height = (image.height / image.width) * width;

        let viewAngle = 0.0;
        let id = mxcad.drawImage(100, 100, width, height, viewAngle, "test.jpg", true, image.width, image.height,"",imagData);
        mxcad.updateDisplay();
    })
```

```ts
const mxcad:McObject = MxCpp.getCurrentMxCAD();
mxcad.on("selectChange", (ids: McObjectId[])=> {
     if (ids.length == 0) return;
     let id = ids[0]
     let ent = id.getMcDbEntity()
     if(!ent) return
     console.log(ent.objectName)
})
```

### pathMakeClosed

▸ **pathMakeClosed**(): `void`

Closed path

#### Returns

`void`

**`Example`**

```ts
import { MxCpp } from "mxcad"

 let mxcad = MxCpp.getCurrentMxCAD();
//Use Plyline to display and draw rectangular boxes

//Define the starting point of a path
   mxcad.pathMoveTo(0, 300);

//The next point on the path
   mxcad.pathLineTo(100, 300);

//The next point on the path
   mxcad.pathLineTo(100, 400);

//The next point on the path
   mxcad.pathLineTo(0, 400);

//Set the path to closed
   mxcad.pathMakeClosed();

//Close the path and generate a rectangular box
   mxcad.drawPathToPolyline();
```

___

### pathMakeExclude

▸ **pathMakeExclude**(`isExclude`): `void`

Mark the current path as an exclusion marker, mainly used for filling and drawing. Dig out the closed area composed of this path in the filling process

#### Parameters

| Name | Type | Description |
| :------ | :------ | :------ |
|IsExclude | boolean | Exclude or not|

#### Returns

`void`

**`Example`**

```ts
//Draw a solid object with a curved boundary filling, and cut a piece in the middle

   import { MxCpp, McObject } from "mxcad";

   const mxcad:McObject = MxCpp.getCurrentMxCAD()
   
//Define the starting point of a path
   mxcad.pathMoveToEx(440, 3310, 0, 0, 0);
//The next point on the path
   mxcad.pathLineTo(480, 3310);
//The next point on the path
   mxcad.pathLineTo(480, 3360);
//The next point on the path
   mxcad.pathLineTo(450, 3340);
//Fill in the exclusion area with the path definition defined above
   mxcad.pathMakeExclude(true);
//Define the starting point of a path
   mxcad.pathMoveToEx(400, 3300, 0, 0, 0.3);
//The next point on the path
   mxcad.pathLineTo(500, 3300);
//The next point on the path
   mxcad.pathLineTo(500, 3400);
//The next point on the path
   mxcad.pathLineTo(400, 3300);
   mxcad.drawColor = new McCmColor(255, 25, 0);
//Turn the path into a padding
   mxcad.drawPathToHatch(1);
```

### regen

▸ **regen**(`delayTime?`): `void`

After redrawing all objects on the graph and calling ZoomAll and ZoomW, it may be necessary to delay the call to Regen before it takes effect due to asynchronous execution.

#### Parameters

| Name | Type | Default value | Description |
| :------ | :------ | :------ | :------ |
|DelayTime | number | 0 | execution time|

#### Returns

`void`

**`Example`**

```ts
import { MxCpp, McObject } from 'mxcad'
 const mxcad:McObject = MxCpp.getCurrentMxCAD()
//Draw a circle with width
   mxcad.addLinetype("CircleLineType", "30,-5,7,-7");

//Design the current line type as' CircleLineType '
   mxcad.drawLinetype = ("CircleLineType");

   mxcad.drawLineWidth = 40;

   mxcad.drawCircle(600, 800, 120);

   mxcad.zoomAll();
   mxcad.regen();
   mxcad.updateDisplay();
```

```ts
import { MxCpp, McObject, MxTools } from "mxcad"
const mxcad:McObject = MxCpp.App.getCurrentMxCAD()

}, false, false)
```

### saveFileToUrl

▸ **saveFileToUrl**(`sSaveProgramUrl`, `call`, `filename?`, `param?`): `boolean`

Save the file to the server and convert it to a network path for download

#### Parameters

| Name | Type | Description |
| :------ | :------ | :------ |
|SSaveProgramURL | string | Backend POST request interface, specific implementation of the interface: First download the MxDraw cloud map development package< https://www.mxdraw.com/download.html >And unzip and find MxDrawCloudServer \ Bin \ MxDrawServer \ Windows \ routes \ mxcad \ upload.exe to find the corresponding implementation interface "/savdwg", "/mxcad/savdwg": save dwg file to server "/mxcad/savefile": save mxweb file to server "/mxcad/savepdf": save pdf file to server. If not found, search for the definition of this interface under this project, which must comply with the definition of this interface to be used as a parameter|
|Call | (iResult: number, ServerResult: string)=>void | Save file result callback. The parameters received here should be based on the location where the drawing is saved according to the interface definition, Ref.file is not the complete request path, it is only the name of the saved drawing|
| `filename?` | `string` | - |
| `param?` | `any` | - |

#### Returns

`boolean`

Has the file been successfully saved

**`Example`**

```ts
import { MxCpp, McObject } from "mxcad"
//Save DWG file
const mxcad:McObject = MxCpp.getCurrentMxCAD()
 MxCpp.getCurrentMxCAD().saveFileToUrl("http://localhost:1337/mxcad/savedwg", (iResult, sserverResult) => {
   let ret = JSON.parse(sserverResult);
   if (ret.ret == "ok") {
       console.log(ret.file)
       let saveFileUrl = "http://localhost:1337/mxcad/file/" + ret.file;
       MxTools.downloadFileFromUrl(saveFileUrl, ret.file);
   }
})
//Save the PDF file.
import { MxCpp, McObject, MxTools } from "mxcad"
const mxcad:McObject = MxCpp.getCurrentMxCAD()
 MxCpp.getCurrentMxCAD().saveFileToUrl("http://localhost:1337/mxcad/savepdf", (iResult, sserverResult) => {
   let ret = JSON.parse(sserverResult);
   if (ret.ret == "ok") {
       console.log(ret.file)
       let saveFileUrl = "http://localhost:1337/mxcad/file/" + ret.file;
       MxTools.downloadFileFromUrl(saveFileUrl, ret.file);
   }
},"",JSON.stringify({ width: "2000", height: "2000" }));
```

### setAttribute

▸ **setAttribute**(`val`): `boolean`

Set global display and run properties.

This method can control some parameters that affect user experience or operational behavior, with common uses including:
-Turn on/off undo rollback;
-Control the display of coordinate axes;
-Adjust display accuracy;
-Switch between black and white display modes.

#### Parameters

| Name | Type | Description |
| :------ | :------ | :------ |
|Val | object | Property configuration object, supports the following common items: 1 Display Precision: Number display precision, ranging from 0 to 1000, with larger values resulting in finer precision; two Enable undo: boolean whether undo/redo is enabled; three ShowCoordinate: boolean Whether to display the XY coordinate axis; four BlackWhiteDisplay: boolean Whether black and white display is enabled.  |

#### Returns

`boolean`

**`Example`**

```ts
import { MxCpp } from "mxcad";
//Retrieve the current MxCAD object
const mxcad = MxCpp.getCurrentMxCAD();
//Set global properties: Enable undo function and display coordinate axis
mxcad.setAttribute({ EnableUndo: true, ShowCoordinate: true });
```

```ts
import { MxCpp } from "mxcad";

const mxcad = MxCpp.getCurrentMxCAD();

  mxcad.showLineWeight(showLineWeight);
}
```

### startBlockEdit

▸ **startBlockEdit**(`idBlockRecord`): `boolean`

Enter block editing mode

#### Parameters

| Name | Type | Description |
| :------ | :------ | :------ |
|IdBlockRecord | [McObject Id] (2d. McObject Id. md) | ID of the block record|

#### Returns

`boolean`

Have you successfully entered the block editing state

**`Example`**

```ts
import { MxCpp, McDbBlockReference, MxCADUtility, MxCADResbuf, DxfCode } from "mxcad";
  async function Mx_StartBlockEdit() {
let retIds = await MxCADUtility.selectEnt(" Select the block reference to be edited ", new MxCADResbuf ([Dxfcode. kElementType," Insert ");
   if (retIds.length == 0) {
       return;
   }
   let id = retIds[0];
   let ent = id.getMcDbEntity();
   if(ent instanceof McDbBlockReference){
       MxCpp.mxcad.startBlockEdit((ent as McDbBlockReference).blockTableRecordId);
   }
  }
```
